epithet.en: Jurist who shaped Finland’s republican constitution and, as its first president, sought to reconcile the defeated Reds

bio.ko: 1865년 수오무살미에서 태어난 법학자로, 청년핀란드당의 입헌주의자로서 러시아화에 법적으로 맞섰다. 1905~1907년 메헬린 상원의 통상·산업 담당 의원, 1908~1918년 헬싱키 대학 행정법 교수를 지냈고 1914년 의회 의장이었다. 1917년 헌법위원회 위원장이 되어 공화국 헌법안을 주도했고, 1918년 승자들의 입헌군주제 구상에 맞서 공화제를 지지했다. 1919년 7월 의회에서 만네르헤임을 143표 대 50표로 누르고 초대 대통령이 되어 소비에트 러시아와의 강화를 지지했으며, 적색 포로 대부분을 사면하고 타르투 조약을 비준했다. 1925년 재선에 나서지 않았고, 1930년 라푸아 운동 활동가들에게 납치되기도 했다. 1952년 숨졌다.
bio.en: Born in Suomussalmi in 1865, he was a jurist and a constitutionalist of the Young Finnish Party who resisted Russification by legal means. He was senator for trade and industry in the Mechelin Senate in 1905–1907, professor of administrative law at the University of Helsinki in 1908–1918 and Speaker of Parliament in 1914. As chairman of the Constitutional Council from 1917 he led the drafting of the republican constitution, and in 1918 he backed a republic against the constitutional monarchy favoured by the victors of the civil war. Elected the first president by Parliament in July 1919, defeating Mannerheim by 143 votes to 50, he favoured peace with Soviet Russia, pardoned most of the Red prisoners and ratified the Treaty of Tartu. He did not seek re-election in 1925, was kidnapped by Lapua Movement activists in 1930 and died in 1952.

bio.ko: 1881년 쿠오피오에서 태어난 통계학자·경제학자로, 1909년 소작제 연구로 박사 학위를 받아 사회민주당의 농업 전문가가 되었다. 1908~1917년 사회민주당 의원이자 당 부의장이었고, 1917년 11월 쿠시넨과 「우리는 요구한다」를 썼다. 내전 때 인민대표위원회 재정 위원으로 3월 1일 소비에트 러시아와의 조약을 협상해 서명했고, 패전 무렵 비푸리 방어를 조직했다. 스웨덴으로 피해 핀란드 공산당 스톡홀름 사무국을 이끌다 1920년 레닌에게 카렐리야 자치를 보고했다. 1923~1935년 카렐리야 자치 공화국 인민위원회의 의장으로 핀란드화 정책을 폈으나 「민족주의적 쇼비니즘」으로 몰려 해임되었고, 1938년 모스크바에서 총살되었다.
bio.en: Born in Kuopio in 1881, the statistician and economist took his doctorate in 1909 with a thesis on crofting and became the Social Democrats’ agrarian expert. He sat in the Diet for the party from 1908 to 1917, was its vice chairman, and in November 1917 co-wrote “We demand” with Kuusinen. In the civil war he was Commissar of Finance of the People’s Delegation, led the talks for the 1 March treaty with Soviet Russia and signed it, and organised the defence of Viipuri at the end. Escaping to Sweden, he headed the Stockholm bureau of the Communist Party of Finland and in 1920 reported to Lenin on Karelian autonomy. As chairman of the Council of People’s Commissars of Soviet Karelia in 1923–1935 he pursued Finnicisation, was condemned for “nationalist chauvinism” and removed, and was shot in Moscow in 1938.

bio.ko: 1884년 얘므새의 가난한 농업노동자 집안에서 태어나 1903년 러시아 군에 들어갔고, 러일전쟁에 중위로 참전한 뒤 1905년 혁명의 사회주의자들과 어울리다 모스크바에서 투옥되고 군에서 쫓겨났다. 핀란드로 돌아와 투르쿠·비푸리·코트카의 노동 신문에서 일하며 사회민주당 당직도 맡았다. 1917년 10월 헬싱키에서 노동자 질서수비대를 조직했고, 11월 총파업 뒤 그 총사령관이 되었다. 1918년 1월 페트로그라드에서 술에 빠지고도 볼셰비키에게서 무기와 탄약을 대량으로 사들였으나, 1월 28일 에로 하팔라이넨으로 교체되었다. 탐페레 전투 마지막 밤 포위를 뚫고 나왔지만 라흐티 부근에서 붙잡혀 1918년 5월 헨날라 수용소에서 총살되었다.
bio.en: Born in 1884 to a poor land worker’s family in Jämsä, he joined the Russian Army in 1903, served as a lieutenant in the Russo-Japanese War, joined the socialists in the 1905 revolution, and was jailed in Moscow and expelled from the military. Back in Finland he worked for the labour press in Turku, Vyborg and Kotka and as a Social Democratic party official. In October 1917 he organised the Workers’ Order Guards in Helsinki and after the November general strike became their commander-in-chief. In January 1918, despite heavy drinking in Petrograd, he bought a large cargo of guns and ammunition from the Bolsheviks, but on 28 January he was replaced by Eero Haapalainen. He broke out of besieged Tampere on the battle’s last night, was captured near Lahti and was shot at the Hennala camp in May 1918.

bio.ko: 1880년 쿠오피오에서 태어나 헬싱키 대학 법학부를 다니다 노동운동에 뛰어들었다. 1905년 총파업 때 헬싱키 적위대 조직자의 한 사람이었고, 1907년 핀란드 노동조합연맹 초대 의장이 되었으나 1911년 음주 문제로 물러났다. 1917년 무장 혁명을 공공연히 주장한 급진파로 적위대 5인 위원회에 뽑혔고, 1918년 1월 군사 훈련도 없이 알리 알토넨의 뒤를 이어 적위대 총사령관이 되었다. 잇단 패배로 3월 20일 해임된 뒤 에드바르드 귈링과 비푸리 방어를 조직하다 5월 페트로그라드로 탈출했다. 망명 핀란드 공산당 창당에 참여했고 카렐리야 노동 코뮌에서 일했으나, 1937년 대숙청 때 체포되어 페트로자보츠크에서 총살되었다.
bio.en: Born in Kuopio in 1880, he joined the labour movement while studying law at Helsinki University. He was one of the leading Red Guard organisers in Helsinki during the 1905 general strike and in 1907 became the first chairman of the Finnish Trade Union Federation, losing the post in 1911 over his drinking. One of the most radical voices of 1917, openly calling for armed revolution, he was elected to the five-man committee of the Red Guards and in January 1918, without any military training, succeeded Ali Aaltonen as their commander-in-chief. Removed on 20 March after a series of defeats, he organised the defence of Viipuri with Edvard Gylling and escaped to Petrograd in May. He helped found the exiled Communist Party of Finland and worked in the Karelian Workers’ Commune, but was arrested in the Great Purge and shot in Petrozavodsk in 1937.

bio.en: Born in Kannus in Central Ostrobothnia in 1873, he emigrated to America at 17, worked in the mines and joined the radical Western Federation of Miners. Back in Finland from 1900, he entered Parliament for the Social Democrats in 1907, chaired the Finnish Trade Union Federation in 1912–1917 and was Speaker in 1913. In 1917 he became vice-chairman of the Senate’s economic department, the world’s first social democratic prime minister. In the civil war he was commissar for supply in the People’s Delegation, signed the 1 March treaty with Soviet Russia and fled to Russia after the defeat. In 1919–1920 he advised the British-organised Murmansk Legion, for which the Communist Party of Finland sentenced him to death. From 1922 to 1949 he edited the social democratic paper Raivaaja in the United States, and the 1944 Lex Tokoi cleared him of the civil war charges.

epithet.en: Petrograd Finnish Bolshevik who helped Lenin escape to Finland in 1917 and sat on the Red Guards’ three-man command in 1918

bio.ko: 1885년 크론시타트의 핀란드인 노동자 집안에서 태어나 페테르부르크에서 선반공으로 일했고, 1903년 러시아 사회민주노동당에 들어가 볼셰비키 편에 섰다. 1917년 여름 레닌의 핀란드 피신을 조직했고, 10월 혁명 무렵 레닌의 경호를 맡았다. 1917~1918년 겨울 동생 유카와 함께 핀란드 적위대의 무기를 구해 왔고, 1918년 3월 20일 하팔라이넨이 해임되자 에베르트 엘로란타·아돌프 타이미와 3인 지도부를 이루었다가 렘팰래 전선 사령관이 되었다. 패전 뒤 붉은 군대 군단장까지 올랐고, 핀란드 공산당에서 쿠시넨·만네르와 다투다 1927년 중앙위원회에서 밀려났다. 1935년 알코올 중독으로 군에서 쫓겨나 사형 선고를 받았으나 1936년 집행 전 결핵으로 죽었다.
bio.en: Born in Kronstadt in 1885 to a Petersburg Finnish working family, he worked in St Petersburg as a turner among other jobs and joined the Russian Social Democratic Labour Party in 1903, siding with the Bolsheviks. He organised Lenin’s escape to Finland in the summer of 1917 and guarded him around the October Revolution. Over the winter of 1917–1918 he and his brother Jukka procured arms for the Finnish Red Guards; when Haapalainen was dismissed on 20 March 1918 he formed a three-man command with Evert Eloranta and Adolf Taimi, then took over the Lempäälä front. After the defeat he rose to corps commander in the Red Army and quarrelled with Kuusinen and Manner in the Communist Party of Finland, which dropped him from its Central Committee in 1927. Expelled from the army for alcoholism in 1935 and sentenced to death, he died of tuberculosis in 1936 before the sentence was carried out.

bio.ko: 1880년 라슈트에서 길란 상인의 아들로 태어나 이란 입헌혁명에 가담했고, 1909년 테헤란을 점령한 입헌파 부대의 하급 지휘관이었다. 1914~1915년 길란의 숲에서 정글리 운동을 일으켜 지방 자치, 중앙정부의 부패 척결, 외세 간섭 중단과 토지 개혁을 요구했다. 1920년 소비에트 함대가 엔젤리에 들어오자 내정 불간섭을 조건으로 손잡고 6월 5일 길란 소비에트 공화국을 선포해 그 수반이 되었으나, 토지 재분배를 거부해 공산주의자들과 갈라섰다. 1921년 5월 정부 수반으로 돌아왔지만 소련이 지원을 끊은 뒤 레자 칸의 정부군에 패했고, 탈레시 산지로 달아나다 동상으로 숨졌다. 잘린 머리는 라슈트에 내걸렸다.
bio.en: Born in Rasht in 1880, the son of a Gilani merchant, he joined the Iranian Constitutional Revolution and in 1909 was a junior commander of the constitutionalist force that took Tehran. In 1914–1915 he launched the Jungle movement in the forests of Gilan, demanding provincial autonomy, an end to central government corruption and foreign interference, and land reform. When a Soviet flotilla entered Enzeli in 1920 he agreed to cooperate on condition of non-interference, proclaimed the Soviet Republic of Gilan on 5 June and became its head, but split with the communists over his refusal to redistribute land. He returned as head of government in May 1921, but after the Soviets withdrew their support he was defeated by Reza Khan’s government troops and died of frostbite while fleeing into the Talesh mountains. His severed head was displayed in Rasht.

bio.ko: 1866년(1870년 설도 있다) 세미팔라틴스크주에서 태어나 옴스크 기술학교와 상트페테르부르크 임업대학을 마쳤고, 아바이 쿠난바예프의 첫 전기를 썼다. 1905년 입헌민주당(카데트)에 들어가 1906년 국가 두마 의원이 되었고, 비보르크 호소문에 서명해 투옥된 뒤 1917년까지 사마라에서 유형 생활을 했다. 1917년 임시정부의 투르가이주 위원이 되었으나 카자흐 자치 문제로 카데트와 갈라서 알라시 당을 세웠고, 그해 알라시 오르다 정부 의장으로 뽑혔다. 1919년 말까지 시베리아의 백군 정부들 편에 섰다가 소비에트 권력과 타협했고, 모스크바에서 출판 일을 하다 1937년 총살되었다. 1989년 복권되었다.
bio.en: Born in Semipalatinsk Oblast in 1866 (some sources say 1870), he graduated from the Omsk Technical School and the Saint Petersburg Forestry Institute and wrote the first biography of Abay Kunanbayev. He joined the Constitutional Democrats (Kadets) in 1905, entered the State Duma in 1906 and, after signing the Vyborg Manifesto, was imprisoned and then lived in exile in Samara until 1917. Appointed the Provisional Government’s commissioner for Turgay Oblast in 1917, he broke with the Kadets over Kazakh autonomy, founded the Alash party and that year was elected head of the Alash Orda government. He sided with the White governments of Siberia until late 1919, then came to terms with Soviet power, worked in publishing in Moscow and was shot in 1937. He was rehabilitated in 1989.

bio.en: Born around 1889 in the village of Koktash in the Emirate of Bukhara, the youngest son of an elder of the Uzbek Lakai tribe, he became bek of his tribe in 1920 and entered the service of Emir Said Alim Khan. After the emir fled he rallied the tribes of eastern Bukhara and led the Basmachi in the name of the emir’s restoration. Championing Islamic conservatism, he drove the Jadids from the movement’s ranks and was so suspicious of Enver Pasha that he once arrested him. After withdrawing to Afghanistan in 1926 he kept raiding across the border and also fought Afghan government troops. Captured while crossing the Kafirnigan River on Soviet territory in June 1931, he was taken to Tashkent and shot on 31 August. Uzbekistan’s Supreme Court rehabilitated him in 2021.

bio.ko: 1880년 부하라에서 에미르 압둘아하드 칸의 아들로 태어나 열세 살에 상트페테르부르크로 보내져 니콜라이 사관학교에서 3년간 통치와 군사를 배웠고, 돌아와 나사프와 카르마나의 총독을 지냈다. 1911년 망기트 왕조의 12대이자 마지막 에미르가 되었다. 즉위 초에는 뇌물과 자의적 징세를 금하는 개혁을 내걸었으나 곧 전통파의 손을 들었고, 1917년 이후 청년부하라인 등 개혁파를 탄압했다. 1918년 3월 콜레소프가 이끈 볼셰비키의 공격을 물리쳤지만, 1920년 8월 말 부하라 작전 중 두샨베를 거쳐 카불로 달아났다. 망명지에서 영국과 손잡고 권력을 되찾으려 했고 바스마치를 지원했다고도 하며, 1944년 카불에서 숨졌다.
bio.en: Born in Bukhara in 1880, the son of Emir Abdulahad Khan, he was sent at thirteen to Saint Petersburg, where he spent three years at the Nicholas Cadet Corps studying government and military affairs, and on his return governed Nasaf and Karmana. In 1911 he became the twelfth and last emir of the Manghit dynasty. He began his reign with reforms against bribery and unauthorised taxation, but soon sided with the traditionalists, and after 1917 he repressed the reformers, the Young Bukharans among them. He repulsed the Bolshevik attack led by Kolesov in March 1918, but during the Bukhara operation at the end of August 1920 he fled via Dushanbe to Kabul. In exile he cooperated with the British in the hope of regaining power and is said to have supported the Basmachi; he died in Kabul in 1944.

bio.ko: 1891년 우랄스크에서 태어나 오렌부르크와 타슈켄트에서 철도 사무원으로 일했다. 1917년 볼셰비키에 들어가 타슈켄트 소비에트 집행위원이 되었고, 제2차 전러시아 소비에트 대회에서 전러시아 중앙집행위원으로 뽑혔으며, 11월 타슈켄트 무장봉기를 조직했다. 1917년 11월부터 1918년 11월까지 투르키스탄 소브나르콤 의장으로서 무슬림을 최고 권력 기관에 들일 수 없다며 연립을 거부했고, 아슈하바드와 코칸트의 자치 시도를 무력으로 진압했다. 1918년 3월 청년부하라인과 함께 부하라 에미르를 무너뜨리려다 실패해 물러났다. 1923~1928년 극동 국민경제최고회의 의장을 지냈고, 뒤에 건축가로 일하다 1940년 모스크바에서 숨졌다.
bio.en: Born in Uralsk in 1891, he worked as a railway clerk in Orenburg and Tashkent. He joined the Bolsheviks in 1917, sat on the executive committee of the Tashkent Soviet, was elected to the All-Russian Central Executive Committee at the Second Congress of Soviets and helped organise the armed rising in Tashkent in November. As chairman of the Turkestan Sovnarkom from November 1917 to November 1918 he rejected a coalition, declaring that Muslims could not be admitted to the supreme organ of power, and put down by force the bids for autonomy in Ashgabat and Kokand. In March 1918 he tried with the Young Bukharans to overthrow the Emir of Bukhara and had to retreat. He chaired the Far Eastern Council of the National Economy in 1923–1928, later worked as an architect and died in Moscow in 1940.

bio.ko: 1857년(1862년 설도 있다) 투르크멘 요무트 부족 지도자의 아들로 태어나 마을의 재판관(카지)과 물 관리인(미라브)을 지냈고, 1912~1916년 투르크멘 봉기로 이름을 얻었다. 1918년 1월 히바의 칸 아스판디야르에게 군 총사령관으로 임명되었으나 칸을 암살하고 그 숙부 사이드 압둘라를 허수아비 칸으로 세워 실권을 쥐었다. 1918년 11월 페트로알렉산드롭스크를 포위했고 1919년 콜차크 정부와 연락했으나, 1920년 초 붉은 군대에 패해 카라쿰 사막으로 물러났다. 이후 호레즘 인민소비에트공화국과 투르크멘 SSR을 거듭 침공해 1924년 1월에는 히바를 포위했다. 페르시아와 아프가니스탄으로 망명해 1938년 헤라트 근처에서 숨졌다.
bio.en: Born in 1857 (some sources say 1862), the son of a Yomut Turkmen chief, he served as a village judge (kazi) and water distributor (mirab) and made his name in the Turkmen uprisings of 1912–1916. Appointed commander of the armed forces of Khiva by Asfandiyar Khan in January 1918, he had the khan assassinated, installed the khan’s uncle Sayyid Abdullah as a puppet and took real power. He besieged Petro-Alexandrovsk in November 1918 and in 1919 opened contact with Kolchak’s government, but in early 1920 the Red Army defeated him and he retreated into the Karakum desert. He then repeatedly invaded the Khorezm People’s Soviet Republic and the Turkmen SSR, besieging Khiva in January 1924. He went into exile in Persia and Afghanistan and died near Herat in 1938.

bio.ko: 1865년 텍사스에서 침례교 목사의 아들로 태어나 1889년 웨스트포인트를 졸업했고, 필리핀-미국 전쟁에 참전한 뒤 육군 참모본부에서 일했다. 1918년 윌슨 대통령의 직접 명령으로 미국 시베리아 원정군을 맡아 9월 블라디보스토크에 도착했다. 정치적 중립을 지키라는 명령에 따라 철도 운행과 체코슬로바키아 군단의 철수에 집중했고, 콜차크 쪽을 도우라는 압력을 거부했다. 세묘노프와 칼미코프 병사들의 살인과 약탈, 일본의 동시베리아 병합 의도를 비판했다. 마지막 미군은 1920년 4월 1일 떠났다. 1928년 퇴역해 회고록 『미국의 시베리아 모험』을 냈고, 1940년 뉴저지에서 숨졌다.
bio.en: Born in Texas in 1865, the son of a Baptist minister, he graduated from West Point in 1889, fought in the Philippine–American War and served on the Army General Staff. In 1918 he was given the American Expeditionary Force in Siberia on the direct orders of President Wilson and reached Vladivostok in September. Ordered to stay strictly apolitical, he concentrated on keeping the railway running and on the evacuation of the Czechoslovak Legion, and refused pressure to help Kolchak’s Whites. He condemned the killing and robbery committed by the soldiers of Semyonov and Kalmykov and suspected Japan of planning to annex eastern Siberia. The last American soldiers left on 1 April 1920. He retired in 1928, wrote the memoir America’s Siberian Adventure, and died in New Jersey in 1940.

bio.en: Born in the Grozny district of the Terek Region in 1890, he graduated from the military school in Tbilisi, transferred to the Ussuri Cossack Regiment in 1914 and won the Sword of St. George in the First World War. Elected ataman of the Ussuri Cossack Host in January 1918, he fought the Bolsheviks and on 5 September took Khabarovsk, becoming head of its garrison. Mass shootings without trial followed in Khabarovsk that year, and the robbery, murder and rape committed by his men outraged White leaders, Kolchak first among them. In February 1920 he secretly handed the gold of the Khabarovsk branch of the State Bank to the Japanese command and crossed into China, where the Chinese authorities arrested him; in early September he was shot while trying to escape.

bio.ko: 1884년 랴잔현의 농민 가정에서 태어나 목수로 일했고, 1906년 징집되어 아친스크의 제29 시베리아 소총연대에서 복무했다. 제1차 세계대전에서 성 게오르기 십자 훈장 네 개를 모두 받아 장교가 되었고 1917년 이등대위에 올랐다. 1918년 3월 러시아 공산당(볼셰비키)에 입당했고, 아친스크가 백군에 넘어가자 지하로 들어가 1919년 1월 파르티잔 활동을 시작했다. 다른 파르티잔 부대와 합친 파르티잔군의 참모장으로 타이가를 700킬로미터 행군해 9월 미누신스크를 차지했다. 1921년 8월 그의 부대가 몽골에서 운게른을 넘겨받았다. 그 뒤 시베리아 국경수비대 참모장을 지냈고, 몽골 군사 고문으로 있던 1927년 울란바토르에서 숨졌다. 사인은 출처마다 엇갈린다.
bio.en: Born to a peasant family in Ryazan Province in 1884, he worked as a carpenter, was drafted in 1906 and served in the 29th Siberian Rifle Regiment at Achinsk. In the First World War he won all four classes of the Cross of St. George, was commissioned and by 1917 was a staff captain. He joined the Russian Communist Party (Bolsheviks) in March 1918; when Achinsk fell to the Whites he went underground and opened partisan operations in January 1919. As chief of staff of a partisan army formed by merging his detachment with another, he marched 700 kilometres south through the taiga and took Minusinsk in September. In August 1921 his detachment took custody of Ungern in Mongolia. He later served as chief of staff of the Siberian border troops, and died in Ulaanbaatar in 1927 while a military adviser in Mongolia; sources differ on the cause of death.

bio.en: Born to a peasant family in Murom district, Vladimir Province, in 1897, he worked as an assistant locomotive machinist. Drafted in 1916, he rose to ensign in the First World War and was twice awarded the Cross of St. George. He joined the Red Guard in 1918, took part in suppressing the Samara rising, and in 1919 formed his own partisan detachment in Primorye. In November he set out for Nikolayevsk-on-Amur with 35 fighters and became commander of the Nikolayevsk Front; he entered the town in February 1920 and won the fighting with the Japanese garrison in March. As a Japanese relief force approached at the end of May he executed all the remaining prisoners and burned the town. In July he was arrested at Kerbi with his staff and, after an improvised trial, shot on the 9th.

bio.en: Born in the village of Inokovka in Kirsanov district, Tambov province, he was conscripted in 1904 during the Russo-Japanese War and stayed on for extended service in St Petersburg. In the First World War he fought in Galicia, winning the full set of four St George Crosses and four St George Medals; he was commissioned in 1915 and made lieutenant in 1917. After the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk he returned home, worked in the local militia and in 1918 formed a partisan detachment. In June 1920 he took command of the 2nd Insurgent Army and in November of the United Partisan Army of the Tambov region, while also chairing the Union of Working Peasantry. The Russian-language source says he was killed in a clash near the village of Bogoslovka on 28 February 1921; the English-language source places his death around June 1921.

epithet.en: Red Army division commander who raised the "Red Army of Truth" against grain requisitioning in 1920

bio.ko: 사마라주 노보우젠스크군의 농민 집안 출신으로, 제1차 세계대전에 참전해 1917년 소위로 노보우젠스크에 돌아와 군 소비에트 초대 의장이 되었다. 좌파 사회혁명당원이었으나 체코슬로바키아 군단 봉기 뒤 공산당에 들지 않은 채 공산주의자를 자처했다. 붉은 군대 제22사단장으로 1919년 우랄스크에서 80일 동안 포위를 버텼지만, 「서툰 지휘와 부대를 해치는 정치」를 이유로 전선에서 물러났다. 1920년 제9기병사단을 편성하다 해임되자 7월 14일 사단을 「제1 진리의 붉은 군대」로 바꾸어 봉기했고, 9월 6일 코임 아울 근처에서 추격대에 사살되었다.
bio.en: From a peasant family of Novouzensk district, Samara province, he fought in the First World War and returned to Novouzensk in 1917 as a second lieutenant, becoming the first chairman of the district soviet. A Left Socialist Revolutionary, after the revolt of the Czechoslovak Legion he called himself a communist without joining the party. As commander of the Red Army's 22nd Division he held Uralsk through an 80-day siege in 1919, but was removed from the front "for inept command and a corrupting policy". In 1920, while forming the 9th Cavalry Division, he learned of his dismissal and on 14 July renamed the division the "1st Red Army of Truth" and rose in revolt. He was killed by a pursuing detachment near the aul of Koim on 6 September 1920.

epithet.en: Red Army commander who was chief of staff of the Tambov suppression and became a historian of the Civil War

bio.ko: 1883년 오룔의 세습 귀족 장교 집안에서 태어나 니콜라이 군사아카데미를 마치고 참모본부 장교가 되었고, 제1차 세계대전에서 사단 참모장 직무를 맡았다. 1918년 우크라이나 인민공화국 군에, 1919년 갈리치아군에 복무했다. 1920년 붉은 군대에 들어가 폴란드-소비에트 전쟁에서 제10사단과 제3군을 지휘했고, 1921년 투하쳅스키 아래 탐보프 진압군 참모장으로서 독가스 사용을 명한 명령 제0116호에 서명했다. 같은 해 공산당에 입당했다. 1923년 붉은 군대 참모부 내전사 부장이 되어 세 권짜리 내전사를 썼다. 1930년 체포되어 1936년 야로슬라블 감옥에서 숨졌다.
bio.en: Born in Oryol in 1883 into a hereditary noble family of army officers, he graduated from the Nicholas General Staff Academy and in the First World War served as acting chief of staff of a division. In 1918 he joined the army of the Ukrainian People's Republic and in 1919 the Ukrainian Galician Army. Joining the Red Army in 1920, he commanded the 10th Division and the 3rd Army in the Polish–Soviet War; in 1921, as chief of staff of the Tambov forces under Mikhail Tukhachevsky, he co-signed Order No. 0116 on the use of poison gas against the insurgents. He joined the Communist Party the same year. In 1923 he became head of the Civil War history department at the Red Army Staff and was one of the authors of a three-volume history of the Civil War. Arrested in 1930, he died in Yaroslavl prison in 1936.
